decisions.choice: HF rows get sha256 = sha256('hf-overthelex:'+text_hash), page_text = [] and redacted_text = one pseudo-page; raw full_text is never stored
decisions.justification: judgment.sha256 and page_text are NOT NULL (schema/corpus.ts:92-96); storing raw text would keep party names (D-053); the namespaced hash cannot collide with a PDF sha256 that #1173 later stores through storeJudgment (ingest.ts:100-110)
